text.p: Investment bank Schroders Plc announced on Thursday a management shake-up of its key operations on Thursday, naming David Challen as chairman of its merchant banking arm J. Henry Schroder & Co Ltd.
The appointment would take effect from January 1, 1997.
Challen, who was currently vice chairman of J.Henry Schroder & Co, would replace Jean Solandt, retiring at the end of the year after 28 years with the group.
Schroders also reported changes in its asset management operations.
John Govett is to join Schroders' board immediately and would "take on a wider group management role, while remaining responsible for the overall asset management of the group."
He will hand over chairmanship of Schroder Investment Management Ltd at the end of the year to David Salisbury, joint chief executive of the division.
Hugh Bolland would remain as chief executive of Schroder Investment Management Ltd, Schroders said.
